basic_details.job_title: NTPC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 12 General Manager, Executive Posts
basic_details.short_information: NTPC Limited (A Govt. of India Enterprise), New Delhi, is recruiting experienced professionals for 12 posts under Advt. No. 17/26. The posts are one General Manager (Chemical Process Plant) in E8 Grade (IDA Rs. 1,20,000-2,80,000/-) and 11 Executive posts on a fixed term of 3 years at a monthly consolidated Rs. 1,50,000/- in CCUS, Coal Gasification, Solar Thermal, Chemical Process and Metallurgy. The General Manager post needs a B.Tech/BE in Chemical Engineering with 23 years' experience. The Executive posts need a B.E./B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech or Ph.D (M.Sc also for Metallurgy) with 12, 10 or 4 yea

how_to_apply: Only online applications will be accepted; no other mode of application is accepted, and no document is required to be sent by post.
Log on to the NTPC careers website careers.ntpc.co.in and open the application for Advt. No. 17/26 between 13.11.2026 and 27.11.2026 (till 06:00 PM).
Use a valid email ID; NTPC will not be responsible for bouncing of any email sent to candidates.
Pay the application fee if you belong to the General/EWS/OBC category (details below).
If you paid at an SBI branch, fill in the Journal Number and Branch Code issued by the bank in the online application.
Upload all the documents listed below while applying; applications with incomplete or insufficient documents are liable to be rejected or not considered for further process.
After applying online, download the application slip generated by the system with the unique application number and retain a copy for future reference.

Payment in offline mode: State Bank of India collects the fee in a specially opened account (A/C No. 30987919993) at CAG branch, New Delhi (Code: 09996), on behalf of NTPC. Take a printout of the "pay-in-slip" from the application portal to the nearby SBI branch; only the pay-in-slip printed from the portal should be used. NTPC will not be responsible if a fee is deposited in the wrong account.
Payment in online mode: through Net banking/Debit Card/Credit Card, available in the online application form.
Fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, so check eligibility before paying.
Class X passing certificate/Marksheet, PAN Card and Aadhar Card (Name and DOB should appear in conformity on all documents).
B.E/B.Tech/M.Sc/M.E/M.Tech/Ph.D Final/Provisional certificate (as applicable) in the required discipline.
Consolidated Marksheet/Transcript/all semester marksheets clearly indicating aggregate % of marks in all semesters.
Marks conversion formula from the university/institute for converting CGPA/CGPI/DGPA/CGI/CPI etc. into percentage.

Caste/Disability certificate for EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwBD candidates, as applicable. The OBC-NCL certificate should be in central format for FY 2026-27; EWS candidates need a current year Income & Asset certificate valid for FY 2026-27 based on the income of FY 2025-26.
Disability certificate in the latest prescribed central Govt. format generated online through the Swavalamban/UDID portal, showing the type and percentage of disability.

All experience documents for each organisation placed together in chronological order: Experience/Service certificate (as per NTPC prescribed sample format), offer/appointment letter, confirmation/absorption letter, joining order, role assignment orders, promotion orders, transfer orders, organization charts, 02 pay slips per every year and Form-16 for each organization.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: NTPC Advt. No. 17/26 has 12 vacancies in six posts. The category-wise break-up is as printed in the notice: Reservation for PwBD candidates is as per Govt. Guidelines. The notice calls these projected vacancies, which may increase or decrease as per organizational requirement at the discretion of NTPC management. Identified types of disabilities for all the posts: a) D, HH; b) OA, OL, Dw, AAV, SD/SI*; c) SLD, MI; d) MD involving (a) to (c) above. SD/SI* means SD/SI without any associated neurological/limb dysfunction; SD/SI with associated limb dysfunction is covered under the respective sub-category such as OA or OL. Disability conditions falling under the category "likely to improve" under temporary disability are not eligible for PwBD reservation.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. All qualifications should be full time from Universities/Institutions recognized and approved in India. Age, experience and qualification are all computed with respect to the last date of receipt of online application. For the four Executive posts at Sl. No. 2 to 5, the first two options are the same: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Electrical/Chemical/C&I/Energy/Solar/RE with at least 60% marks from the Recognised University/Institute AND minimum 12 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field, OR M.E/M.Tech in the same disciplines with at least 60% marks AND minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field, OR the Ph.D shown below AND minimum 4 years of post-PhD experience in the relevant field. Minimum 23 years of post-qualification executive experience of Engineering/Erection/Commissioning/Operation or in combination thereof. Of this, minimum 3 years should be as Head of the above department/s in Methanol/Urea/Ammonia/Ethanol/SAF/DME/SNG/Refinery/Fertilizer/Petro-chemical/Oil & Gas/CCUS/Coal-Gasification/Syngas Cleaning/Syngas Utilization/Chemical process plant/s. Knowledge of Fire & Safety System and General HSE guideline applicable in the above industry is essential. For candidates currently working in Govt./PSUs: 08 years' experience must be in the post and scale of Rs. 1,00,000-2,60,000/- or above (IDA payscale)/level 13 Pay level Rs. 1,23,100-2,15,900/- or above (CDA payscale). Post-qualification experience of 12 years, 10 years and 04 years for B.E/B.Tech, M.E/M.Tech and Ph.D holders respectively. Experience in System Design & Engineering/FEED/Project-Management/Erection/Commissioning/Operation/Maintenance of Methanol/Urea/Ammonia/Ethanol/SAF/DME/SNG/Refinery/Fertilizer/Petro chemical/CCUS/Coal Gasification/Syngas Cleaning/Syngas Utilization/Oil & Gas/Chemical Process Plant or combination thereof, along with General HSE guideline. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: General Manager: in addition to the pay scale, DA, other perquisites and allowances, HRA/Company Accommodation, Medical Facilities, PRP, Group Insurance, Terminal Benefits etc. are given as per the Company's Rules in force from time to time. Executive posts: in addition to the consolidated amount, HRA/Company Accommodation, Retention Benefit and Medical facility for self, spouse, dependent parents and two dependent children. The tenure of engagement is 3 years, with a provision of further extension for a maximum of two (02) years based on organizational requirement and the performance of the candidate. Posting shall be at any of the Stations/Projects/JVs/Subsidiaries/Offices of NTPC, and all posts are transferable at the sole discretion of the Management.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: To restrict the number of candidates, the management reserves the right to conduct a multi-stage selection process, if so required. It may comprise application shortlisting/screening (based on qualification/percentage of marks, number of years of required post-qualification experience etc.), a written/computer-based test, a personal interview etc. or a combination of these, or the management may raise the minimum eligibility standards/criteria as per requirement. Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not give a candidate the right to be shortlisted or called for a written test/interview. Before joining, selected candidates must undergo a medical examination by the NTPC Medical Board/Officer, whose decision is final and binding; no relaxation in the prescribed health standards is allowed. Detailed medical norms are available on careers.ntpc.co.in.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NTPC Advt. No. 17/26?
faq.answer: There are 12 vacancies: 1 General Manager (Chemical Process Plant), 4 Executive (CCUS), 3 Executive (Coal Gasification), 1 Executive (Solar Thermal), 2 Executive (Chemical Process) and 1 Executive (Metallurgy).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NTPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 27 November 2026, till 06:00 PM; applications open on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NTPC General Manager (Chemical Process Plant) post?
faq.answer: A B.Tech/BE in Chemical Engineering with at least 60% marks and minimum 23 years of post-qualification executive experience, of which minimum 3 years as Head of department in the listed chemical process industries.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the NTPC Executive posts?
faq.answer: A B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% marks and 12 years' experience, an M.E./M.Tech with at least 60% marks and 10 years' experience, or a Ph.D in the specified area with 4 years' post-PhD experience; the disciplines differ by post, and M.Sc in Metallurgy/Material Science is also accepted for Executive (Metallurgy).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NTPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 55 years for General Manager (Chemical Process Plant) and 54 years for the Executive posts, counted with respect to the last date of receipt of online application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of NTPC Executive on fixed term basis?
faq.answer: Executives get a monthly consolidated amount of Rs. 1,50,000/- plus HRA/Company Accommodation, Retention Benefit and Medical facility; the General Manager post is in E8 Grade, IDA Rs. 1,20,000-2,80,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for NTPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General/EWS/OBC candidates pay a non-refundable Rs. 500/-; SC/ST/PwBD/XSM category and female candidates need not pay the fee.

faq.question: Q8. How to apply for NTPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at careers.ntpc.co.in, upload all required documents and download the application slip; no other mode is accepted and nothing is to be sent by post.

faq.question: Q9. How will NTPC select candidates for these posts?
faq.answer: NTPC may conduct a multi-stage selection process comprising application shortlisting/screening, a written/computer-based test, a personal interview or a combination of these, followed by a medical examination before joining.

faq.question: Q10. How long is the tenure of the NTPC Executive posts?
faq.answer: The tenure of engagement is 3 years, with a provision of further extension for a maximum of two years based on organizational requirement and the candidate's performance.
